flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati.
If any bills or people are already listed, @v16:"clear this site's browser storage and reload so the app starts empty".
In the people section, add three people one at a time: type Ana and click the add button, type Ben and click the add button, type Cy and click the add button.
Confirm Ana is listed exactly once.
Confirm Ben is listed exactly once.
Confirm Cy is listed exactly once.

In the bill form, type Rent in "Bill name", type 900.00 in "Amount", choose Ana in "Paid by", keep all three people Ana, Ben and Cy selected for the split (equal), then click "Add bill" exactly once.
Confirm exactly one Rent bill is listed.

In the bill form, type Electricity in "Bill name", type 300.00 in "Amount", choose Ben in "Paid by", keep Ana, Ben and Cy selected for the split (equal), then click "Add bill" exactly once.
Confirm exactly one Electricity bill is listed.

Click the Delete button on the Electricity bill row only.
Do not delete the Rent bill.
Confirm Electricity is gone and the single Rent bill is still listed.
Without deleting or changing any other bill, open Settle up and read the payment lines.
Assert Settle up shows "Ben pays Ana 300.00".
Assert The Electricity bill is no longer listed.
Store The payment line shown for Ben in Settle up as 'settle_line'.

verdict.root_cause: The test started with saved information already on the page, but the agent did not successfully remove all saved site data and confirm the page was empty after reloading.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent did not establish a clean starting state before stopping. Although it reported clearing local storage and cookies, the required browser-storage reset was not completed or verified: the people list still showed the prior entries after reload. There is no evidence that the app ignored a correctly completed reset.
verdict.bug_title: Incomplete browser-storage reset left prior people in place
verdict.suggestion: Reset all storage for the site, including any database storage in addition to cookies and local storage, reload, and verify that both people and bills are empty before adding Ana, Ben, and Cy.
